'''''Baanu Kor''''' was a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Koros-Strohna|worldship]].

==History==
[[Nen Yim]] grew up on the ''Baanu Kor''. She used the [[Vul Ag protocol]] to fix its [[endocrine cloister]].
